freshCentralReadAndBindRequired.rule: Central must rerun or consume a fresh zero-write read after P0297 release and sign every current value; neither source evidence nor inherited tuples are a write authority.
freshCentralReadAndBindRequired.parentReceipts: full device/inode/uid/gid/mode/nlink/bytes/type plus direct-child count and canonical inventory SHA-256; each must be a non-symlink directory with required traversal permissions
runtime: current symlink full tuple/target/resolved binary tuple+bytes+SHA

freshCentralReadAndBindRequired.newPathContract: Every P0298 target below is absent, non-symlink and under its exact signed parent immediately before placement; all candidate traversal checks must pass as the actual ynx service user before the current switch.

postCleanupFailureReceiptContract.ordering: After the first owned mutable operation, each failure trap first performs its signed cleanup or automatic rollback, then emits only the three safe fields. It never print env values, credentials, response bodies or path inventories.
postCleanupFailureReceiptContract.preSwitchAndLater: Any failure after env/current/service mutation invokes exactly one automatic rollback restoring signed old env/state/current/service and verifies old live receipts before phase output. Manual rollback remains separately leased.
postCleanupFailureReceiptContract.fixtureProof: Actual-shell fixture proves PREWRITE_CANDIDATE_INTEGRITY before writes, SERVICE_USER_ACCESS cleanup before switching, and CANDIDATE_VERIFY automatic rollback after restart.

executionContract.directInvocationOnly: Central must sign one exact 25-element argv and stdin bytes/SHA. Invoke it directly; the outer observer may capture only process rc and must not create, open, redirect, truncate, append or pipe to declared stdout/stderr/receipt paths.
executionContract.terminalGate: A remote exit 0 is accepted only with the nonempty signed terminal receipt. Any nonzero, silent receipt, stale tuple, output precreation or incomplete rollback is fail-closed and consumes the lease.

rollbackAndResidueGates.successTerminal: After verified deployment success, the exact signed P0298 release container, release, backup, executor and signed lease remain as rollback material; current resolves to the exact candidate release, the candidate service PID/NRestarts and live gates match the terminal receipt, and all pending and temporary paths are absent. Success does not require restoring the old runtime or deleting retained rollback material.
rollbackAndResidueGates.automaticRollbackTerminal: After any failure following an owned write, automatic rollback restores the newly signed old env/state/current/service and verifies the old live receipts before terminal failure emission. Only identity-bound P0298 stage, backup, release, control, pending and temporary objects are removed; every such owned residue is absent after rollback, retained parents match the newly signed baseline, and foreign or substituted objects are preserved fail-closed.

singleBlocker: Central must first release P0297, then provide a new P0298 Finance-only single-use deployment lease with fresh signed baseline, paths, stdin identity and literal argv.
